topic: Ignoring HOA fine letters vs demanding the written rule and a hearing (Wade vs Priya)

scenes.narration: Unpaid homeowners association fines can become a lien and cost people their homes. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom beside a small house wrapped in a giant chain with a tag labeled HOA LIEN, comic burst banner reads FINES BITE BACK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wade and Priya both get HOA letters fining them for fence colors.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man wade and woman priya each opening a letter stamped HOA FINE NOTICE, colorful fences behind them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: An HOA must cite a real rule and offer a hearing first.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an open rulebook on a courtroom bench titled HOA BYLAWS AND HEARING RIGHTS, a wooden gavel resting on it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wade tosses the letters, calling the whole board petty and powerless.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man wade laughing while dropping unopened letters into a trash can, comic banner reads THEY CANT TOUCH ME, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Late fees and daily penalties stack onto his unpaid balance.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a growing tower of fine slips beside man wade, a rising bar chart labeled DAILY PENALTIES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Priya requests the exact bylaw section and her hearing date in writing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman priya at a desk writing a letter labeled CITE THE BYLAW AND SET MY HEARING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The board cannot point to any rule covering her fence color.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, three flustered HOA board members flipping through a rulebook with blank pages, a banner reads NO RULE FOUND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her fine is dismissed at the hearing and removed from record.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman priya smiling as a fine notice is stamped DISMISSED at a hearing table, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wade's fines grow into a lien recorded against his home's title.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a house deed document being stamped LIEN RECORDED, man wade watching in shock, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His refinance collapses because the lien must be paid off first.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man wade at a bank desk as a loan officer slides back a paper stamped REFINANCE DENIED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Priya owes nothing and her neighbors copy her written hearing request.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman priya on a sunny sidewalk handing copies of a letter to smiling neighbors, a note labeled ZERO OWED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Never ignore HOA letters. Demand the written rule and request your hearing. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads DEMAND THE RULE REQUEST THE HEARING, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
